descripcion: The critic wants to know whether you know how to look: turn around, find slot 21 and bring him its postcard.

pasos.texto: Walk up to slot 21, on the door wall (to the right as you enter)
Pick up the postcard of slot 21
Take the postcard to the critic, next to the mural

textos.aceptada: Slot 21 is on the door wall, to the right as you enter.
textos.completada: The critic nods: you looked where nobody looks.

notas: Gallery template. When there are artworks, the owner replaces the hint with one about an artwork («find the painting where the sea is not blue»).
